Rewind to one of my favorite conversations. 💭 What if the thing you’ve been taught to see as a weakness is actually pointing you toward your greatest strength? In my conversation with Bryce Dallas Howard, we talked about how her learning disability shaped the way she sees herself, her strengths, and the way she works. Sometimes the thing that makes you feel different can become the very thing that helps you find your path. ✨ Want to hear the full conversation with Bryce? Comment GIFT and I’ll send you the episode. 👇

Some weeks are full of wins. Others are just about making it to the other side. Whatever this week held for you, you made it through. And that counts. 🤍 Take a breath. Give yourself some credit. Now enjoy your weekend.

Happy October! 🍂🎃 There’s something about this time of year I just love. The summer travels wind down, the pace gets a little slower, and sweater weather gives me an excuse to cozy up and actually sit still for a minute. 😂 So I made myself an October bingo card with a few of my favorite fall things! 🎃👻🍁 What’s in store for you this October? 🍂

You keep saying “someday.” Someday when you have more time. Someday when the timing is right. Someday when everything is figured out. But here’s the thing: your life is happening today. ❤️ Don’t wait so long to start living the life you want that you forget to enjoy the one you have. What’s one thing you’re done putting off until “someday”? 👇

Elizabeth Gilbert's new paperback, All the Way to the River, is out today! 📚✨ So we're bringing back this conversation because there are some ideas that are just too good not to revisit. I loved this conversation with Liz. She is full of wisdom, honesty, and reminders about trusting yourself and following what feels true. Congratulations, Liz, go grab her new paperback! ❤️ Comment READ and I'll send you the full episode. @elizabeth_gilbert_writer

Sometimes you don’t need more answers. You need to ask yourself better questions. 🧠✨ Take a few minutes today to slow down, get quiet, and check in with yourself. You might be surprised by what comes up when you stop looking outside yourself for the answer. Which question made you stop and think? 👇

Your morning routine might be sabotaging your productivity before your day even starts. 📱🧠 The second you open your phone, you’re letting other people’s priorities, notifications, and noise into your brain before you’ve had a chance to focus on your own. Try this instead: give yourself a little time in the morning before you reach for your phone. Protect your attention. Protect your energy. And start your day on your terms. ✨ Could you go phone-free for the first 30 minutes of your day? 👇

Outside of work? 😂 I like to dance, laugh, play, explore, and enjoy the heck out of this wild little life. 💃✨ Because building a meaningful business matters to me, but so does having a life I actually love living. Reminder: You’re allowed to be more than what you do for work. ❤️ What’s your favorite thing to do when you’re not working? 👇

Let's bust a few myths that might be keeping you stuck. 🧠 Sometimes the thing standing between you and your goals isn't a lack of ability. It's what you believe is possible. We all pick up beliefs along the way that sound like facts, until we question them. A little perspective shift can open up a whole new set of possibilities. ✨ Which belief are you ready to question? 👇

Excuse me… WHAT?! 😉 Before B-School, Sarah Hawkey was running around NYC piecing together voice lesson gigs, calling it a side hustle. Now she runs a real business. This is her story, in her own words. When your income more than doubles, it's definitely worth celebrating. But the number isn't the whole story. Behind that kind of growth is someone who decided to bet on their ideas, learn what they didn't know, and actually take action. Because building a business isn't just about making more money. It's about building the skills, confidence, and belief in yourself to create something that can grow. And sometimes the results are so good you have to do a double take. 👀 💬 Want the details on B-School? Comment BSCHOOL below and I'll send them straight to your DMs. 👇

Growing up, fitting in felt like the only option. 🤝 But hiding parts of myself hurt more than I ever let on. Carissa Schumacher put it perfectly in our conversation: you are not an a la carte menu, picking which pieces of yourself are safe to show and which ones need to stay hidden. Let's embrace our entire selves, and support each other as whole people. ❤️ Comment CARISSA and I'll send you the full episode.

I didn’t start out knowing exactly what I was doing. 😂 I bartended while building my coaching business. I tried different careers. I took plenty of wrong turns. And guess what? Some things worked. Some things didn’t. But I kept going. Because failure isn’t proof that you should stop. It’s proof you’re in the game. 🎯 You don’t have to know exactly where you’re going to take the first step. You just have to be willing to be a beginner. ❤️ And if you’re ready to start building a business of your own, I’d love to show you what’s possible. 💬 What's one thing you've been afraid to start because you might fail?

How do you make time for *everything* you love?

💖Nurturing your relationships
👨‍💻Pursuing your dreams
🚵Creating, playing, and adventuring

#Netflix co-founder #MarcRandolph says *that’s* been his life’s work (nope, not founding a $100 billion company). He’s MOST proud of the way he’s answered this question:

“Can I do this thing I love, which is starting and building companies, at the same time that I can have a family, and that I can get outside and enjoy the outdoors?”

Catch today’s #MarieTV📺 at MarieForleo.com/blog or listen on #TheMarieForleoPodcast🎧 to find out how Marc does it — and you can, too.

What if you only had…

💗 One more conversation with your sweetheart
🐶 One more snuggle with your pup
🌳 One more walk around your neighborhood

How much more PRECIOUS would those experiences be? How fully would you show up, pay attention, and savor the sound of your partner’s voice and the smell of the trees?

Today on #MarieTV, the legendary @edmylett is here to help you get super-present and reignite your joy in living through #ThePowerofOneMore.

As Ed says, “You're one decision, one relationship, one thought, one new emotion, one interview, one book away from completely changing your life.”

👉 Link in my bio or go watch now on MarieForleo.com/blog or 🎧#TheMarieForleoPodcast on @Spotify or @ApplePodcasts.

P.S. Yes, Ed has vacation homes, private jets, a deep voice, bulging muscles, and a $450+ million net worth… ✈️💰🏠 But what you might NOT know is that he’s truly one of the most loving, warm-hearted, and genuinely caring people I know. 💗🤗So if you haven’t had the pleasure of meeting him, go watch today’s episode now!

Contrary to popular belief… CARING is NOT a weakness!

To be successful, take risks, and have a voice, you *don’t* need to harden your heart or stop caring what other people think and feel. But you DO need to grow your confidence. 🚀

Today on #MarieTV, the incomparable @lisabilyeu will help you:

🌬️ Release your insecurities
💗 Befriend your inner critic
💪 Feel more confident NOW

Click the link in my bio to watch on @youtube or listen to #TheMarieForleoPodcast on @spotify or @applepodcasts.

And remember… It’s human and 100% normal to care what people think of you. If you’re an empathetic, compassionate person, that’ll never fully go away. I’ll always care what others think of me and my work because I care about my impact. Like Lisa, caring is my superpower. 🤗

What’s your superpower? Comment below and let us know. 🦹👇
